description: Compute month-end Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) for the subscription service for January through March 2025. A subscription is active on a month-end date M if start_date <= M and (end_date IS NULL or end_date > M); end_date is exclusive (the first day the subscription is no longer active). Monthly plans contribute their price; annual plans contribute price / 12. Output columns: month_end (DATE), mrr (FLOAT64, 2 decimals), active_subscriptions (INT64).

end_date.description: First inactive day (exclusive); NULL if still active

price.description: Price per billing period in USD

edge_cases: Subscription starting on the month-end date itself is active that month
Subscription whose end_date equals the month-end date is NOT active (exclusive end)
Annual plans must be normalized to a monthly amount
Subscription that starts and ends within the same month never appears in any month-end MRR
common_failure_modes: FM2: Treating end_date as inclusive (end_date >= month_end) overstates MRR by counting churned subscriptions
FM3: Summing the annual price without dividing by 12
FM4: Computing month end with DATE_ADD(month_start, INTERVAL 30 DAY) instead of LAST_DAY()
